ownership_decision.invariant: eval decides which finished runs still need an evaluation; run only answers which runs finished in a time window, through its read model.

boundary_decision.interaction: eval reads finished runs from the run read model through a function injected at the worker entrypoint, as it already reads run facts for an evaluation.

domain_forces: The evaluation of a finished run was triggered only by the run-succeeded and run-failed outbox events; once an event was dead-lettered or the evaluation job was discarded, the run showed as not evaluated forever and nothing noticed.
implementation_design.decision: A periodic job pages through runs that finished as succeeded or failed between a day and 30 minutes ago, keeps those with no evaluation record, and enqueues them through the existing unique enqueue; evaluation itself is idempotent.
invariants_preserved: A run whose evaluation job is still live is not enqueued twice.
Cancelled and timed-out runs are not evaluated.
rejected_alternatives: Re-delivering dead-lettered outbox events: it misses evaluation jobs discarded after the event was delivered, and it replays events to every consumer.
implementation_design.counterfactual_check: Enqueueing a run even when it already has an evaluation fails TestAFinishedRunWhoseEvaluationNeverStartedIsEnqueuedAgain.

record.statement: Every run that finished as succeeded or failed is evaluated even when the event or job that triggers its evaluation exhausted its retries: every 30 minutes, runs that finished more than 30 minutes and less than a day ago and have no evaluation record are enqueued for evaluation again, through the same enqueue that ignores a run whose evaluation job is still live.
examples: A succeeded run whose run-succeeded event was dead-lettered has no evaluation; the next sweep enqueues it. A cancelled run, a run that finished ten minutes ago, a run that finished two days ago and a run that already has an evaluation are left alone.

approvals.scope: A finished run whose evaluation trigger was lost is enqueued again
